description: A DEBUGGING fixture, not a grading dataset. Three rows — two deliberately narrow briefs that cap their own scope (4 pages, 3 sample rows per table) plus the shared negative-test row — chosen to exercise the judged path, the negative path and a between-row comparison for roughly a third of the tokens a real row costs. The briefs constrain output length on purpose, so scores from this dataset are NOT comparable to ten-industries and must never be used to calibrate a baseline or judge a prompt change. Row ids are stable across every stage.

rows.prompt: Build a minimal internal stock-lookup tool for warehouse staff. Keep it deliberately small: exactly 4 pages (Dashboard, Items, Item Detail, Settings), one table per page with at most 3 example rows, and no more than 2 sentences of prose per section. Target audience: warehouse floor staff. No template or design system has been selected — use your own judgment, plain and functional. Brevity is a hard requirement: this brief exists to keep the spec short.

Build a minimal internal helpdesk ticket viewer for an IT team. Keep it deliberately small: exactly 4 pages (Queue, Ticket Detail, Agents, Settings), one table per page with at most 3 example rows, and no more than 2 sentences of prose per section. Target audience: internal IT support agents. No template or design system has been selected — use your own judgment, plain and functional. Brevity is a hard requirement: this brief exists to keep the spec short.
